why.sideEffects: Without it Rollup cannot drop unused modules, and the route chunks stay merged into one bundle. The two entries are the exceptions: CSS and i18n init do work on import.
why.scripts.build: The prerender runs as part of build, never as a separate step someone can forget.
why.scripts.lint: --max-warnings 0 — a warning nobody must fix is a warning nobody reads.
why.packageManager: Yarn 1 is end-of-life and cannot install Vitest at all; it fails resolving vite as a peer even in an empty project. See docs/adr/0004.
why.remove.react-helmet-async: Unmaintained and never supported React 19, which hoists <title>/<meta> natively. src/components/common/Meta.tsx replaces it.
